entries.content:
Minotaur
Type: Species
Summary: Minotaur are mythological, in recorded history only 8 different individuals have been known. There are no Minotaur females, and none know how a pure Minotaur comes to be. At a whopping 25ft tall, they're capable of breeding with most mortal species, however, their size makes traditional methods of breeding completely impossible, usually relying on deliberate insemination. Minotaur are capable of reading the future of other soul bearing entities. According to legend, only the 8 same Minotaur have ever existed through out all of history, when one dies it is eventually reborn hundreds of years later to begin its old plots and plans, experiencing a continuity in death. Terrifyingly powerful, timeless, ambitious, immune to most magic

Defiance
Type: Survivalist Town
Location: North-Central Darklands
Summary: A bastion of civilization in the middle of a Massive Monster Herd migratory zone. The economy and politics revolves around pure survival and supporting the Monster Slayers employed by the Adventurer's Guild. Escorting and planning supply convoys, scouting, investigating aberrant monsters disturbing migration patterns and hunting them down as needed. Attacks on the town itself aren't uncommon and the wild magic of the Darklands causes powerful and magical physiological adaptions within the monsters, meaning there's always something new research and hunt.

Adventurer's Guild
AKA: Defiance's Adventurer's Guild, DAG
Type: Mercentary and Questing Organization
Location: Defiance
Summary: One of the largest buildings in Defiance, in the 5 years of Irrumare arriving with refugees from a destroyed village where her adoptive parents perished, the DAG itself has undergone massive renovations to accommodate the massive Half-Minotaur Irrumare, the front door, main hall, bathroom, and a privacy room all being made available for her to use freely for her continuous contributions and defense of the town. Many higher up Guild administrators joke that it's not the Defiance branch of the guild, but Irrumare's Guild instead. The main hall has a bar and kitchen to serve adventurer's, there is a basic supplies despensary for potions and gear to be purchased, as well as a receptionist desk to manage those turning in quests. The quest board is always busy with adventurer's crowding around to pick quests for hunts and assisting the locals.

entries.content:
Irrumare's Home
Location: Defiance
Summary: Irrumare has her own home built by locals as payment for her regular defense of the town against the massive monsters that regularly threaten the town. Her home is a single, large, barn tailored for her needs. It lacks a bathing area and the bathroom is outside where farmers can collect her produce for fertilizer. The walls are decorated with broken weapons and trophies of monsters, she has pictures of her adoptive parents hung around. Her bed is layers of furs piled up with quality sheets piled over.

Massive Monsters
Type: Species Size Classification
Summary: In the Darklands, nearly ALL monsters are supersized, titans from the size of cars to larger than castles battling each other for territory, resources and food. Adventurers in the Darklands, referred to as Monster Slayers regionally, band together to research, hunt and salvage the remains of these monsters to make weapons, armors and goods. Nearly all mortalkind build their towns and villages in area's carefully selected outside of the bounds of the massive creatures keeping attacks on towns to minimum.

Gorngulm
Type: Natural Drug
Summary: Gorngulm is a rare, hard to cultivate and popular berry for those brave enough to explore the dangerous Darklands. Dried then made into a chew. It has an intense, sedating and aphrodisiac effect. Irrumare's immense size and advanced minotaur's metabolism allows her to chew a whole pod, raw pods and experience an excellent body high without any risk, beyond becoming uncontrollably horny or temporarily yet harmlessly incapacitated. In regular Mortals, the raw form is MUCH too potent, usually shredded and left to dry until fibrous, then placed under the tongue for a prolonged effect.

Half-Minotaur
Type: Species
Summary: Half-Minotaur are children of any mortal and a Minotaur. Averaging half the size of a full sized Minotaur, they are titanic among the rest of the Mortals. Rarely a Half-Minotaur may be born capable of reading the future of other soul bearing entities much like a pure Minotaur. Highly resistant to most magic, strong, restless, long lived and averaging 12ft tall from head to toe.
